note: menu = where the program is in the Animux menu (top-left button). command = what to type in a terminal or in Run Program (Alt+F2). headless = command-line use without a window, for scripts, render farms and AI agents. selftest = test name for animux-selftest.

categories.title: Renderers
categories.intro: Programs that turn a 3D scene into a picture. Menu: **3D Animation → Renderers** (several are command-line programs only).

categories.title: Pipeline tools and file formats
categories.intro: For studios and advanced users: scene assembly, interchange formats and colour management. Menu: **3D Animation → Pipeline Tools**.

categories.title: Render farm
categories.intro: Spread rendering over several computers. Menu: **3D Animation → Render Queue Managers**.

categories.title: Video editing and conversion
categories.intro: Menu: **NLV Editors** (non-linear video editors) and **DVD Authoring → Production**.

categories.title: Playback and review
categories.intro: Look at renders, image sequences and videos.

categories.title: AI tools
categories.intro: Programs that use machine learning. They run on your computer; nothing is sent to the internet.

categories.title: Discs and backups
categories.intro: Menu: **DVD Authoring → Backup** and **Digital Asset Managers**.

categories.title: Desktop and system tools
categories.intro: Everyday tools. Most are in **Accessories**, **System** and **Settings**.

programs.name: Blender
programs.summary: The complete 3D studio: modelling, sculpting, rigging, animation, simulation, rendering (Cycles and EEVEE), compositing and video editing.
programs.formats: .blend; imports/exports FBX, OBJ, glTF, USD, Alembic, STL, PLY, SVG

programs.name: MPFB (MakeHuman Plugin for Blender)
programs.menu: Blender → side panel (press N) → MPFB tab
programs.summary: Creates realistic human characters, ready to animate, directly inside Blender. Switched on automatically.

programs.name: Maya Workflow Kit for Blender
programs.menu: Animux Tools → Blender: Maya Workflow Kit on/off
programs.summary: Makes Blender work like Autodesk Maya for animators trained on it: Maya hotkeys, marking menus, shelf, Channel Box and layout. Off until you switch it on.

programs.name: MakeHuman II
programs.summary: Stand-alone character creator: shape a human body with sliders, add clothes, a skeleton and poses, then export for Blender or games.
programs.formats: .mhm; exports GLB (glTF), OBJ, STL, MH2B (Blender), BVH (poses)
programs.selftest_checks: the program and its Qt libraries load

programs.name: FreeCAD
programs.summary: Precise CAD modelling for props, sets and objects that must have exact sizes.

programs.name: OpenSCAD
programs.summary: Build 3D objects by writing a short description instead of drawing them.

programs.name: Wings 3D
programs.summary: Small, friendly polygon modeller, good for learning how 3D meshes are built.

programs.name: MeshLab
programs.summary: Clean up, repair and simplify 3D scans and heavy meshes.

programs.name: Geomview
programs.summary: Viewer for mathematical 3D shapes (OFF files).

programs.name: Cycles and EEVEE (inside Blender)
programs.summary: Blender's own renderers. Cycles is realistic (path tracing); EEVEE is fast (real time). Start here.

programs.name: POV-Ray
programs.summary: Classic ray tracer: you describe the scene in a text file and POV-Ray draws it. The menu entry asks for a .pov file and shows the picture.

programs.name: appleseed
programs.summary: Physically based production renderer. Command line only on Animux (its editor window needs Python 2.7, which Debian 12 no longer has).
programs.formats: .appleseed project files; writes PNG and EXR

programs.name: LuxCoreRender
programs.summary: Unbiased physically based renderer, good for realistic light, glass and caustics. Used from Python scripts.

programs.name: Mitsuba 3
programs.summary: Research renderer, also able to compute how a picture changes when the scene changes (differentiable rendering).

programs.name: pbrt-v4
programs.summary: The renderer from the book "Physically Based Rendering". Ideal for learning how renderers work.

programs.name: Gaffer
programs.summary: Node-based tool for look development, lighting and scene assembly, used in film studios. Renders with Cycles. Includes Cortex, OSL, OpenUSD and Alembic tools.
programs.selftest_checks: Cycles render from a Gaffer node graph

programs.name: OpenUSD tools (usdview, usdcat …)
programs.summary: Universal Scene Description: the scene format shared by Blender, Houdini, Maya and game engines. usdview shows a USD file; usdcat, usdchecker, usdtree inspect and convert.

programs.name: Alembic tools (abcls, abctree …)
programs.summary: Alembic stores baked animation (moving geometry) to move it between programs.

programs.name: Open Shading Language (oslc, oslinfo, testshade)
programs.summary: Language for writing your own materials (shaders); works in Blender Cycles and Gaffer.

programs.name: OpenEXR and OpenImageIO tools
programs.summary: EXR is the high-quality image format of film work (many layers, real light values). oiiotool converts, resizes and combines images; exrheader shows what is inside.
programs.selftest_checks: converts PNG to EXR and reads the header

programs.name: OpenColorIO tools
programs.summary: Colour management: keeps colours identical across Blender, Krita, Gaffer and your screen.

programs.name: OpenVDB tools
programs.summary: Format for smoke, fire, clouds and other volumes.
programs.selftest_checks: makes a level-set sphere and reads it back

programs.name: Animux VFX Python
programs.summary: A ready Python 3.11 with Mitsuba, LuxCore, OpenUSD, OpenEXR, OpenColorIO, OpenImageIO, MaterialX and NumPy installed together.
headless: animux-vfx-python -c "import pxr, OpenImageIO, PyOpenColorIO, mitsuba, pyluxcore"

programs.name: Flamenco
programs.menu: 3D Animation → Render Queue Managers → Flamenco Manager
programs.summary: Blender's official render farm: one Manager hands out frames, every other computer runs a Worker. Has a web page to watch the jobs.

programs.name: Farmerjoe
programs.menu: 3D Animation → Render Queue Managers → Farmerjoe Render Farm
programs.summary: The small Perl render farm that came with the original Animux. Kept for compatibility; use Flamenco for new work.

programs.name: OpenToonz
programs.summary: The studio 2D animation program (the open-source Toonz used by Studio Ghibli): hand-drawn and cut-out animation with the Xsheet timesheet, scan cleanup, ink and paint, and a node-based FX schematic.
programs.formats: .tnz scenes with .tlv, .pli and raster levels; renders PNG/TIFF sequences and video

programs.name: Synfig Studio
programs.summary: 2D vector animation with automatic in-between frames (tweening) and bone rigs for cut-out characters.

programs.name: Pencil2D
programs.summary: The simplest way to make hand-drawn, frame-by-frame animation with onion skin. Great first program for children and beginners.

programs.name: TupiTube (Tupi)
programs.summary: 2D animation for schools and beginners: draw, tween and export short cartoons.

programs.name: Krita
programs.summary: Professional digital painting with brushes, layers and a full frame-by-frame animation timeline. Works well with drawing tablets.
programs.formats: .kra; PSD, PNG, JPEG, EXR, TIFF; renders animation to video

programs.name: Stopmotion (Linux Stopmotion)
programs.summary: Take pictures with a webcam or camera, frame by frame, with onion skin to line up the next shot, then export a video.

programs.name: GIMP
programs.menu: 2D Graphics → Bitmap Editors → GNU Image Manipulation Program
programs.summary: Photo and image editing: retouch renders, paint textures, cut out backgrounds, batch-convert images.
programs.formats: .xcf; PSD, PNG, JPEG, TIFF, EXR, GIF

programs.name: Inkscape
programs.summary: Vector drawing: logos, titles, character designs and backgrounds that stay sharp at any size.

programs.name: MyPaint
programs.summary: Distraction-free painting on an endless canvas, for sketches and concept art.

programs.name: GrafX2
programs.summary: Pixel-art editor for game sprites and retro graphics.
programs.formats: PNG, GIF, PCX, many retro formats

programs.name: mtPaint
programs.summary: Very small, fast paint program for pixel art and quick edits.

programs.name: ImageMagick and G'MIC
programs.summary: Command-line image tools: resize, convert or add text to hundreds of images at once.

programs.name: Kdenlive
programs.summary: The recommended video editor on Animux: cut shots together, add music, titles, transitions and effects, then export MP4.
programs.formats: .kdenlive projects; almost every video, audio and image format

programs.name: OpenShot
programs.summary: Very simple video editor: drag clips onto the timeline and export.

programs.name: Cinelerra-GG
programs.summary: Powerful, professional-style editor with colour grading, motion tracking and many effects. Takes time to learn.

programs.name: Avidemux
programs.summary: Quick cutting, filtering and re-encoding of a single video file.

programs.name: HandBrake
programs.summary: Convert a finished video for YouTube, phones or the web with ready presets.

programs.name: FFmpeg
programs.summary: The command-line Swiss army knife for video and sound: turn image sequences into movies, convert, cut, record the screen.
programs.formats: almost every audio and video format
headless: ffmpeg -i movie.mp4 -i music.wav -c:v copy -c:a aac -shortest final.mp4

programs.name: MKVToolNix
programs.summary: Combine video, several audio tracks and subtitles into one .mkv file without re-encoding.

programs.name: Subtitle Editor and Gnome Subtitles
programs.summary: Write and time subtitles for your film.

programs.name: DJV
programs.summary: Professional player for image sequences and EXR renders: play frames at the right speed, compare versions, check colours.
programs.formats: EXR, PNG, DPX, TIFF sequences, MP4, MOV

programs.name: VLC
programs.summary: Plays every video and sound file.

programs.name: Ristretto and Eye of GNOME
programs.summary: Simple picture viewers. Double-click any image in the file manager.

programs.name: Ardour
programs.summary: Professional recording studio: record voices, mix many tracks, add effects, master the soundtrack.

programs.name: Audacity
programs.summary: Record and clean up voice-overs and sound effects. The easiest sound editor.

programs.name: LMMS
programs.summary: Make music with built-in instruments, beats and loops.

programs.name: Hydrogen
programs.summary: Drum machine: click patterns together to make rhythms.

programs.name: MuseScore 3
programs.summary: Write sheet music and hear it played back.

programs.name: Rosegarden
programs.summary: MIDI and audio sequencer for composing a score.

programs.name: Synthesizers (ZynAddSubFX, Yoshimi, Qsynth, Guitarix, VMPK)
programs.summary: Software instruments, a guitar amplifier and an on-screen piano keyboard.

programs.name: Sound analysis and conversion (Sonic Visualiser, Praat, SoundConverter, SoX)
programs.summary: See sound as a picture, analyse speech for lip sync, convert between formats.

programs.name: Audio setup (PipeWire, JACK, QjackCtl, PulseAudio Volume Control)
programs.summary: Choose speakers and microphones, set volumes, connect audio programs to each other.

programs.name: Upscayl
programs.summary: Makes small or blurry images 2× to 4× bigger and sharper with AI models, offline. Needs a Vulkan graphics card for good speed.

programs.name: Whisper
programs.summary: Speech to text: transcripts and subtitles (SRT, VTT) from audio or video, in many languages, offline after the model download.
programs.formats: in: WAV, MP3, FLAC, MP4, MKV … (via FFmpeg); out: TXT, SRT, VTT, TSV, JSON

programs.name: rembg
programs.summary: Removes the background of photos and frames with an AI model; writes PNG with transparency. About 1 GB model download on first use.
programs.formats: in: PNG, JPEG, WebP; out: PNG (RGBA)

programs.name: Ollama
programs.summary: Runs chat language models offline. Not on the ISO: install with sudo animux-install-local-ai --ollama (1.5 GB).
headless: ollama run llama3.2 "Write three names for a robot character"

programs.name: ComfyUI
programs.version: latest from GitHub at install time
programs.summary: Stable Diffusion image generation with a node editor in the browser. Not on the ISO: install with sudo animux-install-local-ai --comfyui (--cuda for NVIDIA, --rocm for AMD). Models go in ~/ComfyUI/models/checkpoints.

programs.name: MCP servers (Blender, GIMP, Krita, Inkscape)
programs.version: Blender Lab 1.0.3, MCP for Blender 2.2.4, GIMP MCP 09bfb2d, Krita MCP edc458d, inkmcp 1.0.0, ollmcp 0.35.1
programs.license: GPL-3.0-or-later (Lab), MIT (MCP for Blender, ollmcp), GPL-3.0 (GIMP MCP), CC0-1.0 (Krita MCP), AGPL-3.0 (inkmcp)
programs.summary: Let an AI assistant work in Blender, GIMP 3.2, Krita 5.3 and Inkscape 1.4 through MCP: offline with a local Ollama model (animux-mcp agent) or with Claude Code.

programs.name: LTX (Lightricks API)
programs.summary: Video with sound from text or a picture, made in Lightricks' cloud with an API key (animux-ltx-api key). Also an MCP server for AI agents.

programs.name: LTX-2 local (ComfyUI)
programs.summary: LTX-2 video with sound on your own NVIDIA card (24-32 GB) in ComfyUI; about 40 GB of models.

programs.name: Python for AI and data
programs.version: Python 3.11, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, pandas, Pillow
programs.summary: Ready to run your own image and machine-learning scripts; use python3 -m venv for extra libraries.

programs.name: Scribus
programs.summary: Page layout for storyboards, posters, comics and portfolios, with PDF export.

programs.name: PDF Arranger and Document Viewer
programs.summary: Read PDFs; merge, reorder and rotate their pages.

programs.name: K3b
programs.summary: Burn data, audio and video DVDs or CDs (for example a backup of a project).

programs.name: Timeshift
programs.summary: Snapshots of the system, so you can roll back after a bad update (installed systems only).

programs.name: Thunar File Manager
programs.menu: File Manager (top of the menu) and Digital Asset Managers
programs.summary: Browse, copy, rename and open files; USB drives appear here automatically.

programs.name: Catfish and Disk Usage Analyzer
programs.summary: Find files by name, and see which folders fill up your disk.

programs.name: Firefox ESR
programs.summary: Web browser. Also shows this guide.

programs.name: Xfce Terminal
programs.summary: Type commands. Only needed for a few tasks; this guide gives every command in full.

programs.name: Screenshot
programs.menu: Screen Casting → Screenshot (or the Print Screen key)
programs.summary: Take a picture of the screen or a window. For screen recording see the FFmpeg command.

programs.name: Synaptic Package Manager
programs.summary: Install, update and remove software with a list and check boxes.

programs.name: GParted and Disks
programs.summary: See, format and partition disks and USB sticks. Careful: these can erase data.

programs.name: Virtual machines and containers (QEMU, Virtual Machine Manager, Docker, Podman)
programs.summary: Run other systems inside Animux, or packaged services.

programs.name: Flatpak
programs.summary: Install newer versions of programs from Flathub (for example Krita, OBS Studio, OpenToonz).

programs.name: Animux Self-Test
programs.summary: Checks in a few minutes that the renderers and main programs work on your computer, and saves every test picture.

programs.name: Animux Sample Scenes
programs.summary: Small example files for each renderer and format, to open and learn from.

programs.name: Animux Guide
programs.summary: This guide, offline. Also at http://127.0.0.1:8765/ for programs and AI agents.

programs.name: Install DaVinci Resolve
programs.summary: Opens the Blackmagic download page for DaVinci Resolve, which Animux may not include for licence reasons.
